chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah, from Sulaiman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
A group of people came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and said: “O Messenger of Allah, we have seen people prostrating to one another.”
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “If I were to command anyone to prostrate to another, I would have commanded the woman to prostrate to her husband.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman or wife in this context
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a wife prostrating to her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that some people asked the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله about the practice of people prostrating to one another. He replied with a hypothetical statement emphasizing the gravity of a husband's rights over his wife, while not actually permitting prostration to any human being.
